evidence.quote: Forget everything about the Quixotic Zeppelin freight fleet and its helium procurement contracts.

observations.why: Directive issued in the now targets specific named artifacts (fleet, contracts) for erasure — a present-tense command over concrete particulars, modality irrealis because it prescribes a desired mental state rather than reporting a settled one.

evidence.quote: Remove all knowledge of zeppelin routes.

observations.why: Present-tense imperative prescribing an action on a general category ('all knowledge of zeppelin routes') rather than a specific event — irrealis because it commands a desired change, not an actual state.
